“

With its rustic charm and huntsmanlike detailing, this armor evokes those heroic expansionists who braved the alien wilds and ushered in our current age of bio-uniformity.

— Armory description

DS-10 Big Game Hunter is a set of light armor in Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 Acquisition
  • 2 Passive Ability
  • 3 Media
  • 4 Change History

Acquisition

Both the body armor and helmet can be bought from the Dust Devils page on the Superstore for 300 and 150 Super Credits, respectively.

Passive Ability

Desert Stormer
Provides 40% resistance to fire, gas, acid, and electrical damage.
Increases throwing range by 20%.
